source.name: NDL PubSec MCP data exchanges feed

caution: relatedApis are found by keyword search of the government API catalogue when the feed is built. A related API is not evidence that the exchange uses it. The register counts agreements, not volume, and records one method per agreement, so API use there is a floor.

register.title: Register of information sharing agreements under chapters 1 to 4 of Part 5 of the Digital Economy Act 2017
register.methodField: Each agreement records exactly one 'information sharing method'. It is the main method declared for the agreement, not every route used: agreements 205, 284 and 663 (the Warm Home Discount helpline, 2022 to 2027) record trusted partner transfer, encrypted hardware or secure file transfer, yet their disclosed-information text says electronic access to DWP's Citizen Application Programming Interface (CAPI) will also be enabled. So API counts from this field are a floor.
register.limits: Covers only agreements under the Digital Economy Act 2017, Part 5; 473 of the 667 have ended, many of them 2019 to 2020 pilots, and 204 are near-identical agreements between DWP and individual energy suppliers for one scheme. It counts agreements, not how much data moves or how often. The largest flows, such as payroll data for Universal Credit and Tell Us Once, run under other legal gateways and are not in it, and much cross-government sharing runs over APIs that the register's single method field does not show. Organisation names were grouped by this server (for example, every energy supplier as 'Energy suppliers'). Contact details on the register were not copied.

exchanges.title: Earnings from payroll to Universal Credit
exchanges.mechanism: DWP's Real Time Earnings system requests RTI data from HMRC for claimants several times a day; DWP passes some PAYE data on to local authorities for Housing Benefit

exchanges.title: Report a death once to many services
exchanges.mechanism: The registrar gives a Tell Us Once reference; the service, run by DWP, notifies the organisations the informant consents to

exchanges.title: Birth, death and marriage registrations shared with services
exchanges.mechanism: Civil registration powers in Part 5 of the Digital Economy Act; many agreements use electronic verification

exchanges.title: Free prescriptions: exemption checked in real time
exchanges.mechanism: Real-time API from DWP to the NHS prescription charge exemption service

exchanges.title: Register to vote: identity checked against DWP records
exchanges.mechanism: The central Register to vote digital service matches applications against DWP data; results go to the electoral registration officer

exchanges.title: Prove your identity once to use government services
exchanges.mechanism: API between GOV.UK One Login and each department

exchanges.title: Help with energy bills: benefit data matched for suppliers
exchanges.mechanism: Data matching; agreements use encrypted email and secure platforms

exchanges.title: Help with water bills: benefit data matched for water companies
exchanges.mechanism: Data matching by secure file transfer

exchanges.title: Debts owed to the public sector: councils, HMRC and DWP
exchanges.journey: Repay money owed to a council or government
exchanges.mechanism: Agreements use secure file transfer and secure platforms; many are council by council

exchanges.title: Free school meals: eligibility checked once
exchanges.mechanism: DfE's eligibility checking service queries DWP, HMRC and Home Office data for local authorities

exchanges.title: Funded early learning and childcare in Scotland
Prove your right to work or rent with a share code
exchanges.journey: Prove your right to work or rent
exchanges.mechanism: Home Office online services; the person generates a share code from their eVisa

exchanges.title: Driving licence applications reuse your passport photo
exchanges.journey: Apply for or renew a driving licence
exchanges.mechanism: DVLA's secure link with HM Passport Office, with the applicant's agreement

exchanges.title: Buying a home: Stamp Duty return to land registration
exchanges.mechanism: The conveyancer files the return with HMRC and sends the SDLT5 with the registration application; the link is a document, not a system-to-system exchange

exchanges.title: Set up a company and register for Corporation Tax together
exchanges.mechanism: Joint service: registering with Companies House usually sets the company up for Corporation Tax too

exchanges.title: Export finance and trade: UK Export Finance and HMRC
exchanges.mechanism: Published HMRC APIs; restricted customs data needs a legal route

exchanges.title: Bid for a public contract: one platform, one data standard
exchanges.journey: Find and bid for a public contract
exchanges.mechanism: All notices under the Procurement Act 2023 are published on the central digital platform, structured in OCDS

exchanges.title: Education funding fraud checks by API
